like post #MeToo I'm kind of sickened by how many folks have turned " horrible abuser is horrible" into new pieces of gossip 

while justifying their own inaction  or ability to decenter their own needs for attention

On of the tweets I most remember making about #metoo 

Was yelling at somebody in Hollywood to go TALK to each other and be honest about it  because if it was always about the perpetrators it would never about us

Honestly folks really thought teh #BLM #MeToo  time was up and it wouldn’t matter and the streamer assured them and here we are 

Except folks don’t need slogans to care that you are an abusive violent jerk or aspire to be one

as #BLM and #StopAsianHate and reporters of color have told us for a while before being shoved out 

Much of news thinks abusing POC is a “debate” of how and to what extent not a problem. 

Republicans are absolutely right and we SHOULD be upset about it

A lot of you do this thing where you accept apologies for people , BEFORE we know what happened fully and then going dead ass silent when it’s revealed 

Its actually abusive and enabling, and you’d think after #MeToo you’d stop but alas

And anybody white talking about the differences in #MeToo but not the racism that came over from  how many people permitted places like Ben Smiths Buzzfeed to fuck Black subjects AND workers 

Can get cussed out along with him
